title: Harpooned
description: Shoot Harpoon on underwater as wind!
body:
## Harpooned

![Harpoon Crossbow](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1697/297/2026-05-24_15-33-03-png.png)

## About This mod

This mod add harpoon weapons inspired minecraft dungeons

### Harpoon

- can shoot with bow and crossbow. It can shoot on underwater and go further!

- can craft with iron nugget, iron bar and stick.

### Harpoon Crossbow

- Harpoon Crossbow is Slower charge, only can shoot Harpoon but make Harpoon more powerful!

- can found in ocean ruins chest
